'''Geonosian Industries''' was a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] company that was a member of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]]. It was eventually controlled by [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During that time, it was responsible for manufacturing thousands of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and other Geonosian-made weapons for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] as part of the Techno Union.

[[Gordarl Weaponsmiths/Legends|Gordarl Weaponsmiths]] and [[Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective/Legends|Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective]] fell under the umbrella of Geonosian Industries. [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata's]] subcontracted Geonosian foundries were also likely part of the greater company.

After Poggle the Lesser's [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|death]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Geonosian Industries was dissolved and [[Imperialization/Legends|imperialized]] by the newly-formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], as part of the broader imperialization of the Techno Union.

==History==
[[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]], who viewed all sentients without wings as inferior castes, were always slighted by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] refusal to accept supremacy of their [[Queen/Legends|queen]]. As a result, when [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] expressed great deference toward the queen caste, the [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] gladly pledged each one of the planet's underground factories to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists']] cause and offered his planet as a meeting place for other Separatist representatives. The Republic, however, soon learned of the meeting after receiving a message from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], which had been retransmitted by his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Kenobi was captured during the end of his transmission, and so the Republic sent a force of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to rescue him, commencing the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]]. As battle droids pinned down the surviving Jedi, the Republic's new [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|army]] arrived and the battle turned in favor of the Republic. The [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]], as well as the newly formed [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] was forced into retreat and Geonosis fell into Republic hands.

Despite this, the resistance from the Geonosians was stronger than the Republic anticipated and they were soon able to regain control of their planet. Poggle then attended a meeting with [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] and [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] senator [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]] in the former's [[Lott Dod's palace/Legends|palace]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] in order to arrange a deal to rebuild the lost [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|Geonosis droid foundries]]. Clovis' guest, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], discovered the true intentions of the meeting, however, and returned the readouts of Poggle's new [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|droid foundry]] to the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]. A full-scale [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|planetary invasion]] was soon prepared by the Republic to regain Geonosis.

Poggle later personally administered the Separatist defense from his primary droid foundry, alongside his personal [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]], [[TX-21/Legends|TX-21]]. When [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] Anakin Skywalker and [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] mounted an offense on the foundry, they sent their Padawans, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] through the catacombs below the factory in order to destroy it from the inside. The two managed to commandeer a [[Separatist super-tank prototype/Legends|super tank]] and destroyed the foundry's main generator, causing it to explode. Poggle, however escaped to the [[Progate Temple/Legends|Progate Temple]] to hide in the company of Queen [[Karina the Great/Legends|Karina the Great]], who planned to use a [[Brain worm/Legends|brain worm]] to control a newly capture Luminara. Anakin and Obi-Wan Kenobi managed to track down Poggle to the temple and fought their way through legions of Geonosian [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]] being controlled by brain worms. The duo captured the Archduke and freed Unduli, escaping as the ceiling collapsed and presumably killed the queen. Poggle was transported to a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] and held in Republic captivity.

Poggle managed to escape Republic custody and joined the Separatist Council for its last meetings on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] and [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], where he and the rest of the Council were [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|killed]] by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader, bringing and end to Geonosian Industries for good.

With rise of the Galactic Empire, the Geonosians were enslaved and played a key role in the construction of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].
